verdict.rationale: dlt is a Python library that is itself a documented, code-first API (pipeline.run(), dataset(), dlt.pipeline, CLI reference dlt-docs-10) and additionally ships an MCP server (dlt-docs-47, dlt-docs-72, dlt-probe-4) exposing pipeline inspection/query tools, giving AI agents a documented interface to drive it. However, there is no traditional REST/HTTP public API (dlt-probe-3 shows openapi.json 404s), so 'documented public API' is satisfied only via the Python SDK/CLI/MCP surface rather than a conventional web API. missing for 10: an HTTP/REST-style public API or OpenAPI spec, and independent third-party confirmation of agents successfully driving dlt purely via the documented API/MCP interface.
